{{Short description|Problem in coordinate geometry}}
{{redirect-distinguish|Distance between two lines|Distance between two skew lines}}

The '''[[distance]] between two [[Parallel (geometry)|parallel]] [[Line (geometry)|lines]]''' in the [[plane (geometry)|plane]] is the minimum distance between any two points.

== Formula and proof ==
Because the lines are parallel, the perpendicular distance between them is a constant, so it does not matter which point is chosen to measure the distance. Given the equations of two non-vertical parallel lines

:<math>y = mx+b_1\,</math>
:<math>y = mx+b_2\,,</math>

the distance between the two lines is the distance between the two intersection points of these lines with the perpendicular line

:<math>y = -x/m \, .</math>

This distance can be found by first solving the [[system of linear equations]]

:<math>\begin{cases}
y = mx+b_1 \\
y = -x/m \, ,
\end{cases}</math>

and

:<math>\begin{cases}
y = mx+b_2 \\
y = -x/m \, ,
\end{cases}</math>

to get the coordinates of the intersection points. The solutions to the linear systems are the points

:<math>\left( x_1,y_1 \right)\ = \left( \frac{-b_1m}{m^2+1},\frac{b_1}{m^2+1} \right)\, ,</math>

and

:<math>\left( x_2,y_2 \right)\ = \left( \frac{-b_2m}{m^2+1},\frac{b_2}{m^2+1} \right)\, .</math>

The distance between the points is

:<math>d = \sqrt{\left(\frac{b_1m-b_2m}{m^2+1}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{b_2-b_1}{m^2+1}\right)^2}\,,</math>

which reduces to

:<math>d = \frac{|b_2-b_1|}{\sqrt{m^2+1}}\,.</math>

When the lines are given by

:<math>ax+by+c_1=0\,</math>
:<math>ax+by+c_2=0,\,</math>

the distance between them can be expressed as

:<math>d = \frac{|c_2-c_1|}{\sqrt {a^2+b^2}}.</math>
More generally, when the coefficients of <math>x</math> and <math>y</math> are different, i.e. the parallel lines are given by the <math>a_1 x + b_1 y + c_1 = 0</math> and the <math>a_2 x + b_2 y + c_2 = 0</math> equations where <math>(a_1, b_1)\ ||\ (a_2, b_2)</math>, the distance can be expressed as <blockquote><math>d = \frac{\sqrt{(a_1 c_2 - a_2 c_1)^2 + (b_1 c_2 - b_2 c_1)^2}}{|a_1 b_1 + a_2 b_2|}</math> </blockquote>
